channel.title: Morning Brief · Salud y seguridad de la familia
channel.description: Retiros de productos, alertas de salud, seguridad alimentaria y desastres

item.title: Un terremoto de magnitud 6.7 sacude los Andes de Perú, sin reportes inmediatos de daños o víctimas
item.description: El USGS registró un terremoto de magnitud 6.7, a 9 km al NE de Carhuamayo, Perú. Se asoció una alerta de tsunami con este evento. [Confirmado] Fuentes: USGS (earthquakes), Associated Press, Reuters

item.title: Federal jury convicts man of starting the deadly 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles
item.description: The 30-year-old LA resident was convicted of arson leading to wildfires that killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings. [Confirmado] Fuentes: Associated Press, Reuters, BBC News

item.title: Honda y Toyota retiran 1.6 millones de vehículos por riesgo de ruptura de bolsas de aire Takata
item.description: Los vehículos todo terreno (ATV) retirados violan la norma de seguridad obligatoria para ATV porque el módulo de ajuste de velocidad incluido con el vehículo permite que la velocidad del ATV se ajuste por encima de la velocidad máxima… [Confirmado] Fuentes: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission, Reuters

item.title: Myanmar dismisses the UN court's ruling on its responsibility for Rohingya genocide as 'unfair'
item.description: A day after the UN’s highest court found that Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya, the President of the General Assembly visited the refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh, urging the world to turn the landmark judgement… [Confirmado] Fuentes: UN News, Associated Press, The Guardian

item.title: Whatever Works Recalls Microwave Grills Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard
item.description: Consumers should stop using the recalled grills immediately and contact Whatever Works for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write in permanent marker “Recalled” on the grill and send a photo of the marked grill to… [Probable] Fuentes: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission

item.title: Xentrawave Recalls Adult Portable Bed Rails Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Asphyxiation; Violate Mandatory Standard for Adult Portable Bed Rails; One Death Reported
item.description: The recalled bed rails violate the mandatory standard for adult portable bed rails because users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress, posing a serious entrapment hazard and risk of… [Probable] Fuentes: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission
